U.S. stock markets traded in a muted, mixed fashion on Tuesday, September 22, 2026, as investors balanced ongoing geopolitical uncertainty with a pause following the previous session's rally. While the Nasdaq Composite reached a new intraday record high, the S&P 500 and Dow Jones Industrial Average experienced slight declines as market participants monitored diplomatic developments at the United Nations General Assembly and awaited further signals from Federal Reserve officials.

Sector performance was divergent, with utilities and basic materials leading the market higher, while financial services stocks lagged amid continued concerns regarding interest rates and Treasury yields.
